analysis_policy.host: mac for all Agent episodes to avoid a host-by-treatment confound
analysis_policy.token_cost_and_wall_time: reported as secondary measurements, not success stopping thresholds

claim_scope: Repository-disjoint development mechanism gate under boundary v3.

exclusions.calibration_case_reason: consumed while repairing the shared measurement boundary
exclusions.prior_boundary_v2_cases: descriptive pilot evidence only; not pooled into this five-pair estimate

mechanism_decision.certification_aware_construction: Compare A versus B on paired Official Pass@1.
mechanism_decision.dormant_loop: If every C first replay passes, do not claim iterative repair and do not add structured state.
mechanism_decision.feedback_conditioned_repair: Count only a C first replay Fail or Unknown followed by a different passing program in the same session and terminal Official Pass.
mechanism_decision.next_algorithm_change: Allowed only after all effective episodes complete and aggregate trajectory error analysis identifies a repeated failure mode.

resource_policy.interpretation: operational safety cap, not a paper-level budget definition
resource_policy.spark_role: source-cache acquisition, cross-platform qualification, and result analysis only; no Agent arm runs

selection.policy: Carry forward positions 4-8 from the outcome-blind boundary-v2 Dev-8 schedule after positions 1-3 were consumed.
